# Akira

> A Discord card collecting bot built for small friend groups. A curated, personal alternative to Karuta - only characters from anime the server actually watches.

## Docs
- Full reference: /llms-full.txt
- Commands: /commands/{name}
- Economy: /economy/{bits,server-pool,personal-milestone}
- Prestige: /prestige/overview
- Getting started: /getting-started/{what-is-akira,your-first-card,importing-from-karuta}
- WebUI: /webui/{authentication,collection,economy-and-leaderboard}

## Summary
Akira drops three anime character cards in a Discord channel. Players grab one by reacting with a number emoji. Owned cards can be viewed, listed, and burned for bits. Text commands use the prefix `a` by default (`AKIRA_PREFIX` overrides it). Slash commands exist for the same actions except grab and `overridekaruta`.

Playable: drop, grab (reaction), view, collection, lookup, wishlist, burn, daily, cooldowns, reminders, frame, userinfo, help, ping. Registered but not finished: multiburn, give, trade, shop, inventory, tags, dye, pool, import.

## Key concepts
- Cards: character art + frame + print number + quality (Common through Legendary). Base arts are equally likely. Alternate arts are rarer. Only Legendary is shiny. Card codes are 7 characters. A card with no frame of its own uses the server default.
- Prefix: `adrop` and `a drop` are the same. Extra words mean the message is not a command. Short aliases are listed on /commands/reference.
- Bits: grab pays 5, daily pays 100 plus passiveBitsBonus, burn pays 10/25/50/100/250 by quality. Shop, pool, and dyes do not spend bits yet.
- Wishlist: unlimited. Akira mentions the player when a watched character is in a drop.
- Reminders: DM when daily, drop, or grab is ready.
- Server default frame: `aframe default <id>` (admin). `aframe card <code> <id|clear>` sets one card.
- Series: `npm run portraits -- <slug>`, then `npm run portraits:install`, then `npm run init`.

## Tech
- Discord.js v14, TypeScript, Node.js ESM
- SQLite via Prisma ORM
- Hosted on Raspberry Pi 5 via Docker
- WebUI: React + Express (also available as a Discord Activity)
- Docs: Astro static site
- Card assets: composed on demand from character art plus a frame, then cached on disk
